items.prompt: The component passes local tests. What is still unverified before using it as a general numerical service?
items.modelAnswer: Its scope is a fixed bounded exact polynomial, not generic callbacks/floating errors. A service needs supported parsing/serialization, resource/security/concurrency/error policies, actual runtime and interface testing; model suitability and user authority remain separate.
